nonlinear_pde.readout_optimization: Common matrix-free damped Gauss-Newton/LSMR; hidden affine/tanh construction fixed; no Adam/LBFGS and no solution-label initialization
nonlinear_pde.constraints: Sampled soft Dirichlet residual on all four faces
nonlinear_pde.genuine_interior_freedom: Degree4 contains (1-x^2)*(1-y^2), which vanishes on the entire boundary; boundary data alone do not determine the field

preconditioner_builds.interpretation: Small regularized Gram blocks; inverse-triangular right preconditioning, reused across nonlinear steps; local row chunks avoid global Jacobian assembly

arithmetic.precision_scope: No certified rounding-error bound; conditioning, feature approximation, and callback cancellation may prevent the requested target

budget.semantics: Soft wall-clock budget between numerical calls, with one trial of an already-computed direction; hard residual evaluation-count limit

solution_metrics.convergence_scope: Declared sampled/aggregated residual blocks only; no continuum error, uniqueness, identifiability, or omitted-condition certificate
solution_metrics.method: Damped Gauss-Newton, matrix-free LSMR, local pointwise Torch derivatives, diagonal/bounded-block right preconditioning with optional automatic selection, projected parameter bounds
solution_metrics.callback_contract: Callbacks must be pointwise across rows; explicit aggregation supplies weak/integral coupling; optional le/ge hinge follows aggregation
solution_metrics.storage_note: Basis jets are cached densely and may exceed the hypothetical global Jacobian size; global residual Jacobian and Gram matrix are not assembled

nonlinear_pde.error_epsilon_units: Errors are absolute unless labeled relative; epsilon=2.220446049250313e-16

four_input_full_degree4_cost_estimate.scope: Algebraic architecture estimate only, not built or run
four_input_full_degree4_cost_estimate.notes: Second-derivative propagation needs several intermediate arrays; total peak would exceed1 GB without chunking. No 4D PDE trial was run.

memory_scope: Whole-process peak includes Python/Torch/BLAS, construction, derivative verification and plotting preparations; architecture parameter bytes separately measure actual dense stored weights
limits: No exact multiplication by finite tanh modules; multiplication and derivatives are approximations.
No PDE solution or interior labels initialize the network; the readout is nevertheless solved iteratively.
Full multivariate feature counts and dense layer weights grow rapidly. Selected deep-product controls are not full high-dimensional polynomial spaces.
Consecutive affine bottlenecks are ordinary MLP layers; fusing them into strictly alternating layers can greatly increase stored dense weights.
Stable analytic chain-rule jets and raw Torch autograd jets are reported separately.
